'''Corgon''' was a group of four [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] that were present at [[Tinoon Station]] when a Pirate [[Skirmish above Tinoon|raid]] took place. The raid consisted of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]], [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifters]], and [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|Marauder-class corvettes]] called [[Wraith (pirates)|''Wraith'']]. The raid was driven off by the station's security as well as the assistance of [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] in the ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]''. The first two had Raw Ore as their cargo while the other two contained grain.
